contest.measure_text: Keppel Union School District Classroom Repair, Safety, Upgrade Measure. To repair leaky roofs, deteriorating plumbing, electrical, gas lines; provide safe drinking water; remove asbestos, lead paint, mold; improve fire safety, security, emergency communications; ensure safe children's play areas; upgrade classroom technology, science labs; shall Keppel Union School District's measure authorizing $27,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levies averaging $30 per $100,000 assessed valuation ($1,700,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, be adopted, requiring oversight, audits, spending disclosure, all funds for local schools? Supporters: Fmr Trustee Dominique Ballante; LocalBiz MonrealAuto; Deputy Sheriff Cronin; LocalBiz QuePaisa; Fmr Trustee Matthew Gaines Opponents: None submitted.
